tools.name: portwatch.advisories.draft
tools.description: Draft a port-to-vessel advisory for a controller to review.
tools.computedBy: src.portwatch_os.advisories (the numbers must come from a model)
tools.returns: The draft advisory. Not visible to the recipient until issued.
failureModes: The advisory is not well formed; the vessel is unknown.

kind.description: arrival_window | speed | berth | holding | approach | cargo_transfer.

recommendation.description: The recommendation payload for this kind.

reason.description: Plain-language justification a master can evaluate.

issuer.description: Name of the controller the draft is raised for.

tools.name: portwatch.advisories.issue
tools.description: Issue a reviewed advisory to its recipient. Requires human approval.
tools.returns: The issued advisory, now visible to the recipient.
failureModes: Not in a reviewable state; the approver does not hold the port.

tools.name: portwatch.advisories.list
tools.description: Advisories visible to a principal.
tools.returns: Advisories with their state, evidence and audit trail.
failureModes: None: an empty register is a valid answer.

tools.name: portwatch.advisories.respond
tools.description: Record a recipient's response to an issued advisory.
tools.returns: The advisory in its new state.
failureModes: Illegal transition; the responder is not the recipient.

tools.name: portwatch.audit.advisory
tools.description: The full audit trail for one advisory.
tools.returns: Every transition with actor, role, timestamp and reason.
failureModes: The advisory id does not exist.

tools.name: portwatch.cargo.opportunities
tools.description: Feasible transshipment connections at a port, ranked by value.
tools.returns: Connections with capacity, window, handling time and value.
failureModes: No observed snapshot for the port.

tools.name: portwatch.cargo.optimize
tools.description: Assign transshipment cargo to onward sailings and yard zones.
tools.returns: Assignments, unplaced shipments with reasons, and the value gap.
failureModes: No observed snapshot for the port.

tools.name: portwatch.company.fleet
tools.description: The signed-in company's fleet and each vessel's current voyage.
tools.returns: Fleet profile with vessels, lanes, ETAs and free capacity.
failureModes: The requested company is not configured.

company_id.description: Optional company id; defaults to the demo carrier.

tools.name: portwatch.company.risk
tools.description: Which vessels in the fleet need intervention, and why.
tools.returns: Ranked vessel exposures with deadlines and recommended actions.
failureModes: The news bundle has not been exported.

tools.name: portwatch.forecast.get
tools.description: The calibrated congestion forecast for one port.
tools.returns: Daily forecast points with q10/q50/q90 bands and a confidence.
failureModes: No forecast artefact was exported for this port.

tools.name: portwatch.global_eye.events
tools.description: Deduplicated, corroborated maritime disruption events.
tools.returns: Events with sources, confidence, severity and calibrated probability.
failureModes: The news bundle has not been exported.

tools.name: portwatch.global_eye.exposure
tools.description: The impact chain for one event: chokepoint, lanes, vessels, ports, actions.
tools.returns: Lane, vessel and port exposure plus the actions the chain supports.
failureModes: The event id is not in the current feed.

company_id.description: Optional. Scope vessel exposure to this fleet.

tools.name: portwatch.learning.outcomes
tools.description: Scored history: calibration, error and the largest misses.
tools.returns: Calibration and error reports sliced by domain, model and horizon.
failureModes: No resolved claims yet, in which case the report says so.

limit.description: How many misses to return. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: portwatch.learning.policies
tools.description: Learned policies and their promotion state.
tools.returns: Policies with evaluation evidence, safety checks and approver.
failureModes: No policy has been trained yet.

tools.name: portwatch.learning.reliability
tools.description: Learned reliability weights per contributor and context.
tools.returns: Weights with sample counts, error and the context each was fitted on.
failureModes: No claims have resolved yet, so the table is empty.

tools.name: portwatch.port_twin.benchmark
tools.description: Compare scheduling policies on held-out simulated scenarios.
tools.returns: Every policy's mean reward, wait, turnaround and violations, ranked.
failureModes: None: the benchmark generates its own scenarios.

tools.name: portwatch.port_twin.simulate
tools.description: Run the port twin forward under a scheduling policy.
tools.returns: Metrics, snapshots at +2/+6/+12/+24h, reward breakdown, violations.
failureModes: No observed snapshot for the port; unknown policy id.

tools.name: portwatch.port_twin.state
tools.description: The digital twin's logical state for one port.
tools.returns: Berths, cranes, yard blocks, sheds, calls and operational metrics.
failureModes: No observed snapshot exists for the port.

tools.name: portwatch.ports.get
tools.description: One port's observed and forecast state.
tools.returns: One port snapshot including its forecast series.
failureModes: The port is not in this run.

port_code.description: UN/LOCODE or model id, e.g. INMAA.

tools.name: portwatch.ports.list
tools.description: Every port in the registry with its observed state.
tools.returns: Array of port snapshots: congestion, delay, risk, queue pressure.
failureModes: The pipeline has not exported port_state.json.

tools.name: portwatch.provenance.get
tools.description: The provenance state of every data source in this run.
tools.returns: Sources with LIVE / CACHED_LIVE / STALE / SYNTHETIC / UNAVAILABLE.
failureModes: The provenance artefact has not been exported.

tools.name: portwatch.routing.optimize
tools.description: Score a passage against weather, port and chokepoint exposure.
tools.returns: Route exposure, ETA effect, chokepoint risk, confidence, provenance.
failureModes: The vessel is not in the fleet; the lane has no catalogue entry.

tools.name: portwatch.scenarios.simulate
tools.description: Propagate a shock through the port network.
tools.returns: Per-port congestion and delay deltas under the shock.
failureModes: The forecast artefact has not been exported.

tools.name: portwatch.weather.get
tools.description: Marine weather observations and the daily impact forecast per port.
tools.returns: Weather signals: wind, gust, rain, visibility, storm risk, impact.
failureModes: The weather artefact has not been exported.

boundary.simulate: Run a model or a what-if. No side effects.
boundary.propose: Create a draft for a human to review.
boundary.execute: Act. Requires an approval context that only an authenticated human session can build, so no agent and no model client can reach one.
